title: Destroy the IT companies list
description:
Destroy the IT companies list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as destroy_companies(companies), which deletes the companies name with del and returns True once it can confirm the name no longer exists (referencing it raises NameError).
hints: The del statement removes a variable name so it can no longer be used.
After deleting a name, referencing it again raises a NameError.
Use del companies, then try to reference companies inside a try/except NameError and return True in the except block.
expected_behavior: Returns True after confirming the companies name has been deleted.
explanation: del companies removes the local binding entirely; trying to read companies afterward raises NameError, which the except block catches to confirm the list was destroyed.
